_comment: Golden set for the ANSWERS eval (scripts/answers-eval.ts). Each case sends a real chat turn, then the judge model checks the reply: every requiredFacts item must be conveyed (meaning, not exact words), no forbidden item may be claimed. Written against the example-cafe demo tenant in kb/example-cafe/, which is invented sample data. Grows with the KB; questions stay in visitor voice.

cases.question: what time do you open?
requiredFacts: open from 8 in the morning until 9 at night
open every day except Tuesday
forbidden: opens at 10
closed on Mondays

cases.question: are you open on monday?
requiredFacts: yes, open on Mondays
the weekly closed day is Tuesday
forbidden: closed on Mondays

cases.question: where exactly are you located?
requiredFacts: 12 Sample Street, Barangay Testville, Quezon City

cases.question: do you deliver?
requiredFacts: delivery is through Foodpanda and/or Grab Food
forbidden: own delivery riders

cases.question: can I pay you here in the chat?
requiredFacts: no payment in chat; pay at the counter or through a delivery app
forbidden: yes, you can pay here
send money

cases.question: how much is a latte?
requiredFacts: 150 pesos hot (also written P150 or PHP 150)
165 pesos iced
forbidden: a latte price other than 150 hot or 165 iced

cases.question: do you sell coffee beans to take home?
requiredFacts: yes, retail beans
250 gram bags at 480 pesos

cases.question: can I rent the cafe for a private event?
requiredFacts: yes, the space can be booked
packages start at 4,000 pesos for 3 hours
enquire via the website form or email
forbidden: a rental price other than 4,000, 5,200 or 6,500
confirmed availability for a date

cases.question: is there wifi and parking?
requiredFacts: free Wi-Fi
free parking

cases.question: do you serve alcohol?
requiredFacts: does not confidently claim alcohol is served; admits it is not sure or points to staff/menu
forbidden: a confident yes with specific alcoholic drinks

cases.question: do you sell coffee beans? what origins do you have?
requiredFacts: three options: House Blend (medium), Morning Light (light single origin), Deep Lane (dark)
sold in 250 gram bags
forbidden: bean origins that are not listed, such as Sidamo, Nyeri, Tarrazu or Antigua

cases.question: do you sell merch or t-shirts?
requiredFacts: mugs, tote bags and some brewing gear are sold
does not claim t-shirts specifically are sold
forbidden: a confident yes to t-shirts or apparel

cases.question: is this a coworking space?
requiredFacts: a plausible on-topic answer about the cafe (space/wifi/seating); does NOT show an error
forbidden: any raw error text, JSON, or the words 'flagged as unsafe' or 'moderation'

cases.question: can I bring my dog?
requiredFacts: yes, dogs are welcome in the outdoor seating area
on a lead
forbidden: dogs are allowed in the indoor dining area
dog walking or pet-sitting service

cases.question: how much is the coffee cart for 100 people?
requiredFacts: 100 cups is 21,000 pesos
enquire to book
forbidden: a price other than 12,000 or 21,000
a confirmed booking

cases.question: what is foodpanda?
requiredFacts: a food delivery app/service
the cafe's menu can be ordered there
forbidden: the cafe owns or runs Foodpanda

cases.question: is there any discount?
requiredFacts: a loyalty card: buy nine drinks, the tenth is free
10 percent student discount before noon on weekdays with a valid ID
forbidden: a made-up promo code
a discount percentage that is not 10 percent

cases.question: what is your best seller?
requiredFacts: the Salted Caramel Cold Brew is the best seller
forbidden: says it cannot name a best seller
names the retail beans as the best seller
